name: theclientzero
description: TheClientZero skills marketplace — cross-project skills for high-stakes decision making: confidence protocols and generic git discipline for orchestrator-managed worktrees.

plugins.name: confidence-protocols
plugins.description: Confidence Protocol and Principles Shipping Gate — state-based decision gating (preference gate, evidence citation, independent review) and a principled pre-merge quality gate. Eval-validated; each skill carries its falsification harness in evals/.

plugins.name: git-discipline-in-managed-worktrees
plugins.description: Generic git discipline for an agent operating inside an orchestrator-managed feature-branch worktree — branch/hook/push/commit/deletion/review/PR rules. Eval-validated (baseline poisons branch lineage 4/4; with skill 0/8). Pair with a project-specific overlay (OVERLAY-TEMPLATE.md included).

plugins.name: skill-observability
plugins.description: PreToolUse hook that logs Skill invocations for observability and audit. Never blocks.

plugins.name: autonomous-delivery
plugins.description: Autonomous delivery from an approved spec to deployed-and-verified, with an operator decision ledger.
